newsitem.title: CHINA: Sino Land sees HK$16 bln 97/98 flat sales.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land sees HK$16 bln 97/98 flat sales.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd said on Friday it plans to launch sales of flats in nine residential property projects during the fiscal year ending June 30, 1998, expected to generate revenues of more than HK$16 billion.
The nine projects in Kowloon peninsula, the New Territories and Hong Kong island will provide a total gross floor area of about 1.99 million square feet, it said in a statement.
"We estimate the sales to generate an income exceeding HK$16 billion," a company official said.
Sino Land also said it would offer 38 units of Grand Palisades at Tai Po, the New Territories, later this month.
The units of Grand Palisades, the second project to be launched in the current fiscal year following the Waterside at Ma On Shan, would be sold at an average of HK$6,388 per sq foot.
The price was more than 10 percent below secondary market prices of flats in the same area, real estate agents said.
Registration for potential buyers of Grand Palisades flats would start from August 9 to 13 and ballot results would be announced on August 15, the company said.
The Tai Po development has a total of nine blocks of nine and 10 storeys, providing 547 units with a total gross floor areas of 200,000 sq ft.
